modelWindow.meaning: Research fixture applicability only. No legal effective dates are asserted.

unsupportedJurisdictions: Other incorporated cities, including County contract cities

sources.publisher: Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety
sources.title: Plan Review & Permitting
sources.support: City building permit and electronic plan-review intake context; no particular review program is selected.
sources.limits: Jurisdiction is externally reviewed at parcel level; all other agency clearances remain outside the model.

sources.title: Building and Safety
sources.support: Unincorporated County building permit authority, Service Locator and EPIC-LA application context.
sources.limits: Contract-city rules and approval are not implemented. Selecting department intake is not permission to build.

sources.title: Unincorporated Los Angeles County
sources.support: Mailing city name does not determine jurisdiction; official jurisdiction lookup is needed.
sources.limits: No GIS lookup result or parcel boundary dataset is bundled; reviewed lookup evidence is an external attestation.

sources.title: EPIC-LA
sources.support: County electronic application and case-management portal context.
sources.limits: Planning and building approvals remain separate; no automatic submission or selection of a planning case type.

sources.publisher: Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety
sources.title: Zoning
sources.support: Official ZIMAS parcel-information context for City of Los Angeles properties.
sources.limits: An externally reviewed lookup attests jurisdiction; lookup authenticity and actual boundaries are not established by this checker.

sources.title: Service Locator
sources.support: Official service-locator destination linked by the County Building and Safety instructions.
sources.limits: No lookup is performed or authenticated; model evidence must be supplied and reviewed for the same parcel.

provenanceLimits: The revision is an authored model identifier, not a cryptographic hash of live agency pages. No source page is bundled or automatically refreshed. Source interpretation and official lookup review remain trusted external inputs.
